content.thinking: Bug in my reference: `words[q]` already contains service *tokens* (I built them with `w + [services[c]]`), so I shouldn't index services again. Fix: `accept = [member(rules, words[q]) for q in range(n)]`.

arguments.command: cd /workspace/dev && sed -i 's|accept = \[member(rules, \[services\[i\] for i in words\[q\]\]) for q in range(n)\]|accept = [member(rules, list(words[q])) for q in range(n)]|' reference.py && timeout 900 python3 reference.py 1 60 2>&1 | tail -8
